name: After § 1
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on narco-trafficking in Europe’s waters: protecting our borders and supporting our law enforcement officers
part_text: 1b. Stresses that Spain’s southern maritime border represents an external border of the entire EU and that the fight against drug trafficking at this border is a shared European responsibility; calls for the swift implementation of the EU drugs strategy and the EU action plan against drug trafficking; calls for Europol, Frontex and Eurojust to provide stronger operational support to the most exposed Member States; calls for the expansion of MAOC-N operations in the Atlantic Ocean and the Mediterranean Sea, for the reinforcement of the European Ports Alliance, for closer operational cooperation with countries of origin and transit, and for increased EU funding for maritime surveillance and interception capacities;
